name: Сварта Дур-Неф
notes: Svarta Dur-Nef, the accountant of Fundin Dur-Krept's mines in Kragmir and one of the three judges at Grog's trial. Dry, exact, and she counts everything: candles, minutes, the cost of a broken knee. The mines are short of strong hands, so she may push the bench toward a sentence of labour in the mines instead of a fine. She is not a fighter; the light pick and the sling are a mine dwarf's habit.

actions.name: Itemized Cost
actions.text: Сварта recites, flatly and without a pause, what a creature within 30 feet that can hear her has broken, spent and owes. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] for 1 round.

actions.name: Work It Off
actions.text: In a legal proceeding, Сварта gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy and Society checks to argue for a sentence of labour in the mines instead of a fine or prison.

rules.label: Work It Off (arguing for mine labour)

actions.name: Counts Everything
actions.text: Сварта has a +4 circumstance bonus to her Perception DC against attempts to [[/act steal]]{Steal} from her or [[/act palm-an-object]]{Palm an Object} near her, and against [[/act lie]]{Lies} about sums, prices and quantities.

actions.name: Mine Accounts Specialist
actions.text: When dealing with the accounts, debts, wages or labour of the Kragmir mines, Сварта is an 8th-level challenge.
